lines.ko: 깨끗한 솔잎을 찜기 바닥에 깔고 송편을 쪘어요.
lines.en: Laying clean pine needles on the steamer floor, they steamed songpyeon.

lines.ko: 솔향기가 배어 나온 송편은 쫄깃하고 달콤했어요.
lines.en: Songpyeon permeated with pine scent was chewy and sweet.

lines.ko: 식사 후에 마당에 나가니 큰 보름달이 떴어요.
lines.en: Going out to the yard after dinner, a big full moon was up.

lines.ko: 환한 달을 보며 간절하게 소원을 빌었어요.
lines.en: Looking at the bright moon, they made earnest wishes.

lines.ko: 민수는 온 가족이 아프지 않고 건강하기를 기도했어요.
lines.en: Minsu prayed for the whole family to stay healthy without getting sick.

lines.ko: 가족이 나누는 따뜻한 정 덕분에 마음이 풍요로웠어요.
lines.en: Thanks to the warm affection shared by family, hearts felt rich.

check.q: For which traditional holiday did the relatives gather at grandmother's house?
check.a: They gathered for the autumn Chuseok holiday.

check.q: What did they lay on the bottom of the steamer when cooking songpyeon?
check.a: They laid clean washed pine needles.

check.q: What wish did Minsu make while looking at the full moon?
check.a: He prayed for his entire family to always stay healthy without getting sick.
